content.title: 'Paradise' Season 2, Episode 7 Ending Explained: Does Samantha Know Link?
content.text: NEED TO KNOW "The Final Countdown," the penultimate episode of Paradise's second season, premiered on March 23The latest installment featured the end for certain characters, while also prompting more questionsParadise season 2 stars Sterling K. Brown, Julianne Nicholson, Thomas Doherty and others Warning! Spoilers ahead for Paradise season 2, episode 7. Things are going bonkers in the bunker as Paradise season 2 nears its climactic conclusion. On March 23, "The Final Countdown," the penultimate episode of the series' second season, dropped on Hulu. The latest entry in the post-apocalyptic series provided closure for certain characters, but it also raised even more questions, revealing a surprising connection between Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond (Julianne Nicholson) and Link (Thomas Doherty). Here's what happened in Paradise season 2, episode 7. Do Xavier and Teri make it to Colorado? Sterling K. Brown as Xavier and Enuka Okuma as Teri in 'Paradise' season 2. Ser Baffo/Disney After their reunion was teased at the end of episode 6, Xavier (Sterling K. Brown) and Teri (Enuka Okuma) are finally back together in "The Final Countdown." They have joined the convoy headed out to Colorado, and in the final minutes of the episode, they are shown riding on the train with Bean (Benjamin Mackey), and Annie's (Shailene Woodley) baby. What happens to Gary? Cameron Britton in 'Paradise' season 2. Disney/Ser Baffo While Xavier and Teri are preparing to leave with the convoy to Colorado, a note from Gary (Cameron Britton) is delivered to Teri. The piece of paper says he has Bean, the young boy who was part of Teri and Gary's survivor group. Teri goes back to the post office to confront Gary and get Bean. Meanwhile, Xavier is stationed with a rifle on a rooftop, ready to shoot Gary through the window, and save his wife, but he doesn't have to resort to killing. Teri convinces Gary to let her and Bean go, and Xavier allows Gary to live. Gary then retreats to the post office, as Xavier, Teri and Bean head back to the train — leaving him behind. Do Link and Samantha meet? Thomas Doherty in 'Paradise' season 2. Disney/Ser Baffo Yes, after agreeing to her terms, Link and Samantha meet in the bunker. Link enters with his men, but he and Samantha have their one-on-one meeting in Air Force One, which is parked nearby inside the bunker. While on the plane, Link initially tells Samantha that he wants one of the nuclear reactors powering the bunker, before revealing that he's actually there for Alex. Samantha then abruptly ends their meeting, and brings Link back to the bunker entrance. Still, Link tells Samantha that he and his men are going to find their way into the bunker. As the two talk, Link's right-hand man, Geiger (Michael McGrady), yells at him to leave, before shouting his real name — Dylan — which is the same name as Samantha's young son who died. Surprised, Samantha asks Link what his birthday is, and he tells her May 16 — the same birthday as her dead son. After he shares his information, he gets a nosebleed — an unexplained occurrence, which Link and Xavier each experienced earlier in the season. He then leaves the bunker, as Samantha's nose also starts to bleed. Notably, Xavier gets a nosebleed as well later in the episode while on the train to Colorado. What happens to Jane? Jonathan Tanigaki, Nicole Brydon Bloom and Miguel Najera in 'Paradise' season 2. Disney/Ser Baffo Throughout the episode, Gabriela Torabi (Sarah Shahi) becomes more suspicious of Jane (Nicole Brydon Bloom), and her paranoia proves to be warranted. Jane sneaks into Gabriela's house to kill her, but the plan is thwarted when Gabriela surprise attacks her in the bathroom, stabbing her in the back. In the process, Gabriela pushes Jane onto the shower floor, and Jane collapses. She appears to be lifeless, but it is not confirmed whether Jane is actually dead or not. Related Stories What are the latest clues about who or what Alex is? Julianne Nicholson in 'Paradise' season 2. Disney/Ser Baffo There is still no confirmation of what or who Alex is, but answers are slowly becoming clearer. In the episode, Link says he is at the bunker for Alex, telling Samantha, "I will find Alex and we will end this." She responds, "I will do everything in my power to protect her, and I won't let you or anyone else destroy what I've built." The episode ends with Samantha taking a small underground train to another secret area of the bunker. When she gets off the train, she walks down a hallway, puts on a blue jacket and enters a room aglow with a warm light. She smiles and says, "Hi, Alex" — but the credits flash on the screen before Alex's identity is revealed.
